impact: VAL-EXP-010 (smoke row 12, must-pass) fails cadence assertion when no display enforcement is applied. PipeWire negotiates the native 4K display at variable-rate (~30fps), producing 960 frames over 31.8s. The cadence gate requires mean in [51..61.2] fps (85–102% of nominal 60). EXP-010 has no kscreen-doctor enforcement unlike VAL-CAP-004 (ISS-021 fix). Smoke execution blocked at row 12; rows 13-20 NOT-ATTEMPTED.
title: VAL-EXP-010 fails cadence gate when display is at 4K native: PipeWire negotiates 3840×2160 variable-rate, meanFps=30.19 outside required [51..61] fps envelope
